page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs using the AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations show strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing in the top 25% of its class. PassMark memory scores also rank in the top tier. However, multi-core performance, Geekbench scores, and static web serving throughput align with average mid-tier expectations. A notable performance tradeoff is the memory write bandwidth for large uncached blocks, which registers in the bottom 25% at 18.87 GB/sec.

Given its high compute-to-memory ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance offers a balanced cost-efficiency profile for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk storage. It is appropriate for tasks such as software compilation, text and image processing, medium-scale database operations, and small-to-medium language model inference.
